versions.changelog:
No visible changes in functionality or documentation for this version.

- Version bump only; no file or content changes detected.

- Initial release of ali-promotion-roi skill for analyzing Alibaba International (alibaba.com) promotion ROI.
- Evaluates total promotion spend vs. completed orders and revenue; supports CPO (Cost Per Order), ROI calculations, and type/date breakdowns.
- Reads from pre-loaded MySQL tables (`alibaba_intl_orders`, `alibaba_intl_promotion_daily`) using sql-linker-cli; does not handle data ingestion.
- Provides CLI for full/monthly reports, USD/CNY rate override, promotion type/date drilldowns, and JSON export.
- Includes clear prerequisites, troubleshooting tips, and guidance on extending the skill.
